string-array.name: import_aegis_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Import & export, and tap Export.
Keep the format on Aegis (JSON) and tap Export. You can leave Encrypt the vault on.
Choose the file here. An encrypted vault opens with your Aegis password.

resources.string: A vault that only unlocks with biometrics can\'t be opened here. Export it without encryption instead.
